text: SIPROTEC 7SD80 provides line differential protection for power cables and overhead lines up to 24 km. It offers selective protection for high-voltage and medium-voltage systems across all starpoint configurations, and is well-suited for replacing analog differential protection.
heading: Why SIPROTEC 7SD80?

text: Boost system availability and operational reliability

Ethernet redundancy protocols (PRP, HSR and RSTP) increase system availability. This enables fast, selective tripping even if relay communication fails, to protect your power cables and overhead lines.
heading: Boost system availability and operational reliability

text: Simplify protection concepts and reduce costs

Implement simplified, cost-saving protection for meshed grids and busbars using reverse interlocking. Streamline your system design, reduce infrastructure complexity, and optimize operational expenses with efficient solutions.
heading: Simplify protection concepts and reduce costs

text: Achieve rapid commissioning with simple settings
Leverage integrated functions and simple settings for faster commissioning. Deploy and configure your protection relays quickly to minimize downtime and accelerate project completion.
heading: Achieve rapid commissioning with simple settings

text: Exchange differential protection data via integrated fiber-optic interfaces up to 24 km or two-wire copper cables up to 20 km. Transmit intertripping and 16 binary signals.
heading: Flexible communication and redundancy

text: Apply diverse protection functions: differential, ground-fault and time-overcurrent. Integrate control and monitoring functions, using them as backup or emergency options for enhanced operational safety.
heading: Diverse protection and control functions

text: SIPROTEC 7SD80 offers 9 programmable function keys, a 6-line display, a buffer battery exchangeable from the front, a USB front port, and 2 additional ports. Set secondary current transformer values (1 A/5 A) using DIGSI.
heading: Convenient, easy-to-use features
